full_prompt_en: A square color editorial cartoon shows a mustached man kneeling among broken stones while firing a dark rifle toward the right. The figure occupies the central lower frame, one knee planted on the rubble and the other raised, making a strong triangular stance. He wears loose green trousers, a dark green vest over rolled-up light gray sleeves, brown lace-up boots, and a black-and-white patterned cloth tied around his head and neck. Short black hair lifts above the band, and a thick black mustache sharpens his tense profile. Both hands grip the weapon firmly; a curved magazine hangs below it and a brown strap loops down. At the muzzle, a bright irregular yellow flash bursts into the clear blue air, with thin yellow sparks and small dark fragments scattered around it. Behind the man, enormous cloudlike plumes of yellow, orange, coral, and magenta smoke fill most of the left and lower background. A pale blue-gray plume rises behind his head, while the upper right remains open sky. Angular chunks of stone and tiny dark marks fly near the right edge. A low broken masonry ledge crosses the bottom, with gray and tan rocks creating a rough stage for the pose. The drawing uses hard black outlines to hold the figure, gun, and stones, while broad saturated color blocks give the smoke a boiling, layered form. Short hatch marks and small tonal patches model the clothes and face, but the sky stays flat and clean. Light seems to come from the orange burst behind and from the muzzle flash, outlining the forward arm and boot with warm contrast. The composition pushes energy diagonally from the lower left figure through the rifle to the bright right-side flash, framed by explosive warm color against calm blue.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色时事漫画呈现一名蓄浓胡须的男子跪在碎石间，朝右开枪。人物位于中央下部，一膝压在碎石上，另一膝抬起，形成有力三角姿态。他穿宽松绿裤，卷起的浅灰袖外罩深绿背心，脚踩棕色系带靴，黑白花纹布包在头与颈周围。短黑发从布带上翘起，厚黑胡加强紧张侧脸。双手紧握武器，弯曲弹匣垂在下方，棕色带子向下绕。一团不规则亮黄枪口火光在右侧清蓝空气里爆开，细黄火星和小暗碎片围着它散落。男子身后，巨大云状黄、橙、珊瑚红和洋红烟团填满左侧及下方大部分背景。一道浅蓝灰烟在头后升起，右上仍是开放天空。棱角石块与微小暗记号飞在右边缘附近。一条低矮破石墙横过底部，灰棕石块为姿势搭出粗糙舞台。绘画以坚硬黑轮廓收住人物、枪和石头，宽阔饱和色块让烟雾翻滚层叠。短排线与小明暗斑塑造衣服和脸，天空却平整干净。光似乎来自背后的橙色爆团及枪口火光，以暖对照勾出向前的手臂和靴。构图把能量从左下人物经枪斜推向右侧亮闪，由爆开的暖色和安静蓝色对照框住。
style_prompt_en: Color editorial cartooning uses bold black contour, compact hatched modeling, and broad saturated planes to communicate abrupt motion. A dense warm cluster of yellow, orange, coral, and magenta expands against a relatively flat cool blue field. One bright ragged accent projects from a strong diagonal line, and tiny scattered flecks carry energy beyond the central mass. Angular dark shapes and rough gray texture anchor the lower edge, preventing the color from floating. Figure-ground separation stays clear through hard outlines even where forms overlap. Light is graphic and localized, expressed by high-value bursts and warm edge contrast rather than smooth natural illumination. The overall rhythm is forceful, legible, and sharply directional.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色时事漫画以醒目黑轮廓、紧凑排线塑形和宽阔饱和色面传达突然动势。黄、橙、珊瑚红与洋红的浓密暖色簇对着相对平整的冷蓝色域扩张。一处亮而锯齿状的重点从强斜线前方射出，细小散点把能量带出中央大块。棱角暗形与粗灰肌理锚住底边，防止颜色漂浮。即使形态叠压，坚硬轮廓仍保证主次分离。光图形化而集中，由高明度爆点与暖边对照表达，而非平滑自然照明。整体节奏有力、清楚、方向明确。
theme_en: A mustached fighter firing a rifle before a burst of orange smoke
theme_zh: 一名蓄须战斗者在橙色爆烟前开枪
name: Carlos Latuff
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
